jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer for Flight Controls (High Lift Systems) (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our flight controls engineering department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Systems Engineer for Flight Controls (High Lift Systems) (d/f/m).

Are you looking for a career opportunity in an international, high-tech environment? Regardless of your experience level, you might want to join our highly motivated team! We are developing, designing, and supporting leading-edge technology, complex, and safety-critical architectures for the High Lift System of flight controls across the Airbus product line using modern development methods and tools.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country's greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It's also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour's drive from the North Sea coast.

Our Benefits for You

Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.

Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Design, development, and integration of the High Lift System and its sub-system control architecture.
- Application of automated controls technology in flight control systems, including assessment of filtering, estimation, and stability needs.
- Definition and identification of checks and balances along the development cycle to ensure product maturity across milestone gates.
- Identification of lifecycle activities to develop, maintain, and support the design/product.
- Definition of work package contents and activities.

Desired skills and qualifications

- University degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in electrical engineering, information technology, systems engineering, or a related field.
- Broad knowledge in at least two relevant disciplines (e.g., communication/controls technology, sensing and data generation, software development, or systems engineering).
- Good understanding of tool applications in Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and/or software development. Knowledge of data analytics would be a plus.
- Strong team player with good communication skills, personal engagement, and adaptability to work in an international environment.
- Willingness to travel for business up to once a month worldwide.
- Advanced language skills in English and German; French skills are an asset.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Finkenwerder

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Company Description

At AUMOVIO, we own what we do: Developing and producing hardware, software, and services that shape the future of mobility. But what truly sets us apart are our people. People who thrive in our winning culture, driven by bold ideas. People who take a leap and create meaningful difference—together. Because we believe that the future belongs to those who own it. Own your career, your growth, your skills, and your impact. Join us and own what’s next.

Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions (AESS) organization has been established in AUMOVIO to develop and manufacture semiconductors in a fabless model to fulfilling strategic internal semiconductor demands.

Job Description

As an ASIC Layout Engineer (m/f/diverse) for AESS (Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions), you will be responsible for the top-level integration of analog and mixed-signal ICs. You will drive the layout development process, ensuring robust, DRC-compliant designs with optimal area utilization. You will collaborate closely with analog circuit designers and other layout engineers to deliver high-quality silicon.

Key Responsibilities

- Drive the top-level layout integration of analog/mixed-signal chips (analog on top)
- Define toplevel floorplan, padframe design and bonding diagrams in coordination with other domains
- Coordinate with other layouters to define floorplans according to the chip top level
- Generate and integrate analog layouts at block and chip level
- Perform pin placement, parasitic extraction, and layout optimization
- Ensure compliance with DRC, LVS, and support tape-out activities
- Collaborate with design engineers to meet speed, area, power, DFM, ESD, and EMC requirements

Qualifications

- Academic degree in Electronics Engineering or related field
- Extensive professional experience in analog layout design
- Proven experience in top-level layout integration
- Strong expertise in BCD technologies (65nm to 180nm)
- Deep understanding of deep submicron effects (parasitics, coupling, matching)
- Proficient in layout tools for design, DRC, LVS, and extraction
- Knowledge of analog circuit design
- Fluent English language skills (both written and spoken), German language skills are a plus

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

About the roleAre you passionate about building high-performing teams, deepening client trust, and turning complex software into a tool people rely on every day?As Team Lead Customer Success, you'll take ownership of our Customer Success function for D3 and OMS clients — banks, traders and technical teams who depend on our systems to price, manage and distribute FX Forward and Swap prices around the clock. You'll lead a team of four responsible for day-to-day client support, build the processes and product expertise that are shared across the team, and shape a more proactive way of working with clients.This is not a role where you inherit a finished machine. You'll inherit a strong product, demanding expert users, a good team, and a function that needs clear ownership, deep product expertise, strong tooling, and a proactive way of working. Working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering, you'll help define what a modern, efficient Customer Success function looks like for our market.This is a hands-on builder role for someone comfortable with ambiguity, who enjoys getting close to the product and the client as much as leading a team.
Your Responsibilities
• Lead and grow the Customer Success team responsible for D3 and OMS clients, taking on full people-management responsibility.
• Own the quality of day-to-day client support, making sure questions are answered quickly, clearly, and to a consistently high standard.
• Own support escalation, ensuring complex, urgent, or sensitive cases move through the organisation in a structured way instead of bouncing between people.
• Build the team's product expertise so that a growing share of D3 and OMS questions can be answered directly, without relying on Product, Engineering, or long-standing individual experts.
• Own onboarding from a Customer Success perspective, so new clients and users understand the product and are set up for success from day one.
• Develop a more proactive way of working with clients — anticipating issues before clients raise them, and identifying where they are not using D3 or OMS to its full potential, reaching out with suggestions rather than only reacting to requests.
• Make client knowledge visible internally by documenting client setup, usage, stakeholders, infrastructure, and recurring issues, rather than letting it live in emails or individual heads.
• Create a structured feedback loop into Product, surfacing patterns, friction, and recurring issues from client interactions, not just direct feature requests.
• Help define and improve the tools, processes, and reporting used by Customer Success, including systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, and Jira.
• Contribute to a clear, shared view of client health, including key users, setup, risks, and commercial opportunities, working closely with Sales.
• Speak directly and frequently with traders, desk heads, application owners, and technical stakeholders at client banks.

Preferred qualifications
• Several years of experience leading a Customer Success, Support, or Client Services team, ideally in enterprise software or fintech.
• A proven ability to build structure, process, and ownership in a function that is still evolving, rather than only maintaining an existing setup.
• Strong technical aptitude and the ability to develop deep expertise in a complex software product like D3. This is not an engineering role, but you need to be comfortable with technical detail and credible with sophisticated users.
• Enough financial-market understanding to grasp why D3 exists, what problem it solves, and what our traders need from it.
• Comfortable engaging directly with senior, demanding stakeholders such as traders and desk heads, as well as technical and operations teams at banks.
• Strong track record of managing escalations and keeping complex cases moving through an organisation without losing ownership.
• Experience building or improving tooling, automation, AI-assisted workflows, reporting, and documentation practices within a support or Customer Success function.
• Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering.
• Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:
• FX, Capital Markets, FICC, Treasury, or electronic trading environments.
• Previous exposure to OMS or similar trading systems.
• Enterprise SaaS support or Customer Success in a technically complex product.
• Experience building a Customer Success function in a small, expert team, with a hands-on approach to clients, product, and day-to-day operations.
• Familiarity with SaaS environments and technical operations — infrastructure, connectivity, system monitoring — even though this role does not own technical operations.
• CRM or ticketing systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, Jira, or Teams.
